mapper.select: SELECT ss.id, ss.court_id AS courtId, c.name AS courtName, ss.sport_type_id AS sportTypeId, st.name AS sportName, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ss.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS startAt, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ss.end_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS endAt, ss.price_fen AS priceFen, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, -v.cancel_cutoff_minutes, ss.start_at), '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS cancelDeadline, CASE WHEN ss.status IN ('HELD', 'BOOKED', 'CLOSED') THEN ss.status WHEN c.status != 'ACTIVE' OR st.status != 'ACTIVE' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_court_sport cs WHERE cs.court_id = c.id AND cs.sport_type_id = ss.sport_type_id) OR ss.start_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, v.min_booking_minutes, #{now}) OR ss.slot_date < #{today} OR ss.slot_date >= DATE_ADD(#{today}, INTERVAL v.booking_days_ahead DAY) THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN ss.status = 'OPEN' THEN 'OPEN' ELSE 'UNAVAILABLE' END AS status FROM s_session_slot ss JOIN s_court c ON c.id = ss.court_id AND c.venue_id = ss.venue_id JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = ss.venue_id AND v.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = ss.sport_type_id WHERE ss.venue_id = #{venueId} AND ss.slot_date = #{date} AND ss.sport_type_id = #{sportTypeId} AND ss.start_at >= #{rangeStart} AND ss.end_at <= #{rangeEnd} AND ss.price_fen >= #{minPriceFen} AND ss.price_fen <= #{maxPriceFen} ORDER BY ss.start_at, ss.end_at, c.id, ss.id
